description: Low-priority idea seeded from vision walk #4 (2026-04-27) chore-audit, sourced from a viral X bookmark about someone using Claude Code to build a personal homelab. Media-server (akin to Plex / Jellyfin / Emby) is a canonical homelab application and would be a natural scenario candidate for the family bundle once that bundle is being actively built out. Local-first, offline-capable, household-focused — fits the family-bundle thesis. Not actionable today; bundle composition is still in design and the dev/solopreneur business bundle is the active priority. Capture for future consideration. Cross-references: knowledge entry research-method/homelab-app-scenario-seeding on director-swarm (homelab-app monitoring as a generative method); AUDIENCE_OBSERVATIONS notebook entry 2026-04-27 (marketing positioning angle for family bundle); initiative bookmark-intelligence-hub-rework-and-ideation (which surfaces this kind of bookmark-derived candidate going forward).
